legend: AML with t(1;22)(p13.3;q13.1). The translocation results from the breakage and rejoining of bands 1p13 and 22q13. G-banded normal chromosomes 1 and 22 are shown on the outside of each pair of homologues, and the points of rearrangement on the derivative chromosomes 1 and 22 from the translocation are indicated by arrows. Note that the dark-staining heterochromatin region directly below the centromere of the derivative chromosome 1 is a normal variant.

Dual-colour dual-fusion FISH strategy with probes for RBM15 (1p13.3) and MRTFA (22q13.1). Representative interphase nucleus with an abnormal RBM15::MRTFA dual-fusion signal pattern (arrow): one red signal for normal RBM15, one green signal for normal MRTFA, and two RBM15::MRTFA fusion signals indicating the 1;22 translocation. A normal nucleus is also present (two red signals for normal RBM15 and two green signals for normal MRTFA).
